entries.0265adb9d25c6b3b: Investors and businesses that purchase real estate for rental business
entries.044901f3dae137ad: With Tokyo and western Chiba Prefecture as its main operating areas, this business leases properties it owns, provides bulk leasing (sublease) of residential rental condominiums and similar buildings, manages properties under management contracts, brokers rentals, collects and manages parking fees, and performs large-scale renovations. It is the core of the company's business and is positioned as a stock-type business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥2,880 million.
entries.0749b51a600538f9: A real estate company centered on the operation and management of rental condominiums in Tokyo and western Chiba Prefecture, which also plans, develops and sells rental condominiums.

entries.2a035d37ac4c1720: Two businesses: Operations and Management, and Development and Sales
entries.526d5356675d249d: Based on the business description stating that brokerage activities play an important role in grasping user needs and rent trends, and on the fact that external customer revenue of the Operations and Management Business, ¥2,880 million, accounts for the majority of consolidated revenue of ¥3,289 million.
entries.533d5033b97756c5: A real estate group centered on operations and management
entries.5c0d49c0c0118aa5: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥280 million.
entries.7ca965930163f3fb: With Tokyo and western Chiba Prefecture as its main operating areas, this business leases properties it owns, provides bulk leasing (sublease) of residential rental condominiums and similar buildings, manages properties under management contracts, brokers rentals, collects and manages parking fees, and performs large-scale renovations.
entries.7d9856db1b45f15a: Owners of company-owned properties and properties under management contracts.
entries.7f18ac69065ac09c: This business plans, develops and sells rental condominiums.
entries.80cf564cb7b81bf3: This business plans, develops and sells rental condominiums. In the rental property market, where securing stable medium- to long-term income is the primary objective, it plans and develops highly competitive properties, with development focused on central urban areas. Once operational, the properties are held as company-owned properties; after sale, they become sublease or managed properties and thus also a source of revenue for the Property Management Business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥409 million.
entries.82773f5d1f34a960: The business model builds stable revenue from operating and managing company-owned and master-leased (sublease) rental apartment buildings and from outsourced management, and also earns revenue from holding and selling rental properties planned and developed in central urban areas.
entries.8373a155ba25e884: It aims to grow stably and sustainably with the Operations and Management Business, which operates company-owned and master-leased properties, as its core business, and states that, to prepare for polarization in the rental market, it will focus development on central urban areas. Its management policy is a thoroughgoing customer-centric principle.
entries.83a99189ded2dea6: Rental income from company-owned and master-leased properties
entries.9fed6f01cac64c7f: Based on the statement of the business environment: net population inflows and the upward trend in housing rents in central urban areas, rising construction costs due to soaring real estate prices and supply constraints on building materials, and concerns about rising interest rates.
entries.aef0d84fc8eedbdf: Centered on the Operations and Management Business, which leases company-owned properties, master-leases properties, manages properties on an outsourced basis and provides brokerage, the company also runs the Development and Sales Business, which plans, develops and sells rental apartment buildings.
entries.b9ba1869a56adfca: Operation and management services for outsourced-management properties
entries.ba0f03f9a8432b30: It is a real estate company operating in an environment in which, in central urban areas, its main business area, housing rents are on an upward trend and demand is firm due to net population inflows, while rising real estate prices, higher construction costs and rising interest rates are concerns.
entries.cc75150d5784cbad: Tenants live in the rental apartment buildings, property owners entrust their operation and management, and investors and businesses purchase the developed rental apartment buildings.
entries.e438914a80879519: EARLY AGE CO., Ltd. is headquartered in Minato-ku, Tokyo, and forms a group together with one consolidated subsidiary. Consolidated employees as of October 31, 2025 were 17.
entries.eb5f2ccf97fca160: It earns revenue from rent on company-owned and master-leased properties, management fees on outsourced-management properties, brokerage fees, and sales proceeds from developed properties. Revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥3,289 million, down 30.4% from the previous year.
entries.f2a34b03d7967820: Its strengths are that, through brokerage activities in the Operations and Management Business, it can grasp the diverse needs of prospective tenants and rent trends and apply that information to planning and development, and that stock-type operations and management through company-owned and master-leased properties account for the majority of revenue.
